page.layout: One page of text; marginal notes in the left margin (running marginal references "Cap.15" and "Vsu." style notes beside the first lines); running head at top; text in a single column; a heading "HOMILIA CXII." centred; catchword "Post-" at lower right.

main_text.p: Cap.15.Sunt ergo certæ sedes animarum, Ioh.14. Piorum in sinu Abrahami, Luc.16 23. Matthæi 8. Impiorum item, &c. Ezech.32. Isaiæ 14.

4. Caro corrumpitur, secundum illud, Gen.3. Arguit hoc factum sepulchrorum. Obseruemus autem finem: Ut induamur incorruptibilitate, 1.Cor.15 Phil 4. Ergo ne nos quidem æternam videbimus corruptionem. Imo in corruptione ista habemus spem resurrectionis. Simile sementis 1.Cor.15 Ioh.12.
Vsu.Hac spe confirmati, Deo constanter seruiamus: simul vigilemus, & sedulo Oremus.
main_text.head: HOMILIA CXII.
main_text.p: 38 Notum igitur sit vobis, fratres, annuntiari vobis remissionem peccatorum per ipsum.
39 Et ab omnibus, a quibus per Legem Moysis absolvi non potuistis, per hunc omnis qui credat, absolvi.
40 Videte ergo, ne vos innuadat quod dictum est in Prophetis.
41 Videte o contemptores, & admiramini, & euanescite: quia opus operor ego diebus vestris, opus quod non credetis, si quis enarrauerit vobis.

page.notes: Marginal references in the left margin at the first lines are partly damaged; "Vsu." mark is a reference mark. Some words in the Latin are set in old spelling and possibly misread; "innuadat" and "operor" are doubtful. Catchword "Post-" printed at lower right.
